mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months indicates a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods with positive housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face production challenges and reduced output.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a monetary tightening cycle that is not supported by strong economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening and weak growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong demand and low unemployment signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month indicates a strong labor market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the easing signal.
